TagLine: Me sell artisan goods. Okay, poke? Bring coines. 20 New Machines and 150+ New Items!
Description:
![](https://i.imgur.com/IguEooX.png)﻿

It's finally here! 'Artisan Valley' is the collaborative effort of the members of Project Populate Json Assets.
Since the days of CustomCrops, @SpringsSong began work on a port of [Mizu's Artisan Goods + Machines](https://community.playstarbound.com/threads/mizus-sprites.136549/)﻿.

⚠️⚠️⚠️⚠️⚠️
IF YOU ARE CONVERTING FROM CFR -> PFM [FOLLOW THIS GUIDE HERE﻿](https://github.com/paradigmnomad/Producer-Framework-Mod---Artisan-Valley)﻿

OR

[USE THIS TOOL](https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4972)﻿ PROVIDED BY DIGUS
Your machines _**WILL**_ disappear if you do not follow [the guide](https://github.com/paradigmnomad/Producer-Framework-Mod---Artisan-Valley)﻿ OR [use the tool](https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4972)﻿.
⚠️⚠️⚠️⚠️⚠️

**![](https://i.imgur.com/LKwk9jp.png)﻿**

- Not all items are craftable yet, this is due to the crops still being made. You can purchase these items temporarily at Pierres.
- If you'd like to use [Quality Artisan Products](https://community.playstarbound.com/resources/quality-artisan-products.5914/)﻿, Wingheart has been so kind as to make a compatible version. You can find it on [Chucklefish](https://community.playstarbound.com/resources/quality-artisan-products-for-artisan-valley.5932/)﻿ and [ModDrop](https://www.moddrop.com/stardew-valley/mods/726947-quality-artisan-products-for-artisan-valley)﻿.

﻿Tired of all of the recipes being shoved into the normal cooking menu? Check out Kaya's wonderful [CCS Kitchen Station Set](https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6305)﻿.

To get the full experience out of Artisan Valley you will need the following (includes dependencies)

﻿- Latest version of [Json Assets](https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1720)
- Latest version of [SMAPI](https://stardewvalleywiki.com/Modding:Installing_SMAPI)
- Latest version of [SpaceCore](https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1348)
- Latest version of [Producer Mod Framework](https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4970)﻿
- [Project Populate Json Assets Content Pack Collection](https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1935)
- Latest version of [Mail Framework Mod](https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1536)
- Latest version of [Content Patcher](https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915)

Optional

- Latest version of [Custom Cask Mod](https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2642)﻿ (optional, to age certain alcohols)https://stardewvalleywiki.com/Modding:Installing_SMAPI- Latest version of [Miller Time](https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7575)﻿ (optional, to put a few things into the mill building)
- Latest version of [Champagne Wishes](https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5721)﻿ (optional, you will have 2 errors that will not impact your game - do not report these)
- Latest version of [Boarding House](https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4120)﻿ (optional, you will have 1 error that will not impact your game - do not report it; submitted by Miu)

* For those who do not want the entire PPJA collection, you need [Fruits and Veggies](https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1598/)﻿, [More Trees](https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1671)﻿, [Mizu's Flowers](https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2028)﻿, and [More Recipes](https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1670)﻿ at a minimum.

OR

[USE THIS TOOL](https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4972)﻿ PROVIDED BY DIGUS
Your machines _**WILL**_ disappear if you do not follow [the guide](https://github.com/paradigmnomad/Producer-Framework-Mod---Artisan-Valley)﻿ OR [use the tool](https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4972)﻿.
⚠️⚠️⚠️⚠️⚠️

Step 1. Install SMAPI, Json Assets, SpaceCore, Content Patcher, Producer Framework Mod, Custom Cask Mod (optional), Miller Time (optional), PPJA Collection (or listed packs) and Mail Framework Mod.
Step 2. Download this mod and extract the zip file anywhere you would like. There are 4 files included in the download:

[JA] Artisan Valley Machine Goods
[MFM] Artisan Valley Letters
[PFM] Artisan Valley
[CP] Artisan Valley

(Optional File) [CCM] Artisan Valley

Step 3. Drag & Drop the extracted folder(s) directly into the /Mods folder.

![](https://i.imgur.com/MnkF0nq.png)﻿

- Delete every existing item and machine made from this mod
- Remove the corresponding folder(s) inside /Mods

**If you miss any (especially in your inventory) you can crash your game.**
